build:worker.//: The Rust Worker (worker-build --release + a name-section strip). Needs the Rust toolchain: see docs/plans/document-parser.md. Cached on the Rust sources, so `test` only rebuilds after a change.

test.//: `cargo test` on the host, then the workerd suite against the BUILT module — hence `build:worker` first.

dev.//: Standalone only. In the stack this Worker runs INSIDE the backend's `lunora dev` session as a service binding (`backend/lunora.config.ts`) and has no port of its own — `pnpm dev` does not start this target. 8792, not 8788: 8788 belongs to the Lunora backend (`PUBLIC_ORIGIN`). Keep this in sync with `package.json`'s `--port`.
